Job Summary
We are hiring an experienced Irrigation Design Engineer in Pune with 4–7 years of expertise in designing efficient irrigation systems. The role involves preparing design drawings, BoQ, cost estimates, and performing technical calculations. Candidates will collaborate with clients and teams while also managing project supervision and reporting. Strong skills in AutoCAD, engineering fundamentals, and data analysis are essential. Join us to work on impactful and innovative irrigation projects.
